description: In SolveSpace, create a new file and draw a 2D rectangle with specific dimension constraints. In the blank canvas, use the Rectangle tool (Sketch > Rectangle, shortcut R) to draw a rectangle: click once for the first corner and again for the opposite corner. Then add dimension constraints (Constrain > Distance / Diameter, shortcut D) so that the rectangle has a width of 80 mm and a height of 50 mm. Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/rectangle.slvs' using File > Save.
